title: Craftable enchanted golden apple
description: Returns the enchanted golden apple craft to Minecraft
body:
This mod returns the enchanted golden apple craft back to Minecraft 1.12.2 and higher!

**Main features:**

- Adds a old recipe without an changes

- Perfect for your survival world
